column1: # SGW.exe function entry points, for naming native addresses in client telemetry.
# Image base 0x00400000; the shipped SGW.exe loads at its preferred base.
# Compiled into the telemetry ingest by client_symbols.rs next to this file (NT-40), which
# names the addresses in client.native rows. It lives here, not in docs/, so the
# container build (which copies crates/ but not docs/) sees it.
# Columns: address<TAB>name<TAB>source, where source is the file that documents the address.
# Add rows from verified RE only. One row per address; a lookup names exact entry points only.
